ability.name: Undead Traits
ability.description: No Constitution score, so no Constitution modifier applies to hit points or Fortitude saves. Immune to all mind-affecting effects, poison, sleep, paralysis, stunning, disease, death effects, critical hits, nonlethal damage, ability drain, energy drain, fatigue, exhaustion, damage to its physical ability scores, and any effect requiring a Fortitude save unless it also works on objects or is harmless. Negative energy heals it; it cannot heal on its own if it has no Intelligence score. Darkvision 60 ft.

attack.name: Fear Aura (Su)
attack.description: Creatures of less than 5 HD in a 60-foot radius that look at the lich must succeed on a Will save (DC 10 + 1/2 lich's HD + lich's CHA modifier) or be affected as by a fear spell from a sorcerer of the lich's level. A creature that saves cannot be affected again by the same lich's aura for 24 hours.

attack.name: Touch Attack (Su)
attack.description: A supernatural touch attack, not a natural weapon: it is taken once per round and gains no iterative attacks. Negative energy deals 1d8+5 points of damage to living creatures; a Will save (DC 10 + 1/2 lich's HD + lich's CHA modifier) halves the damage. A lich armed with a weapon may use the touch as a secondary attack. Unlike vampiric touch it heals the lich nothing.

attack.name: Paralyzing Touch (Su)
attack.description: A rider on the touch attack above rather than a separate action. Any living creature hit must succeed on a Fortitude save (DC 10 + 1/2 lich's HD + lich's CHA modifier) or be permanently paralyzed — remove paralysis or any spell that removes a curse frees the victim, and the effect cannot be dispelled. A DC 20 Spot or DC 15 Heal check reveals that a victim who seems dead is still alive.

ability.name: Immunities (Ex)
ability.description: Immune to cold, electricity, polymorph (though it can use polymorph effects on itself), and mind-affecting attacks.

ability.name: Rejuvenation (Su)
ability.description: Unless its phylactery is located and destroyed, a lich reappears 1d10 days after its apparent death, rebuilt by the life force stored in its phylactery.
